verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen streaming and remote-control app, so user-configured autonomous background automations fall outside its product role. The evidence shows no automation, scheduling or agent features. The only automatic behavior is a built-in daily update check, which users do not set up as an automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
